newsitem.title: POLAND: FORMER DEPUTY FINANCE MINISTER GETS PEKAO SA JOB.
newsitem.headline: FORMER DEPUTY FINANCE MINISTER GETS PEKAO SA JOB.

text.p: Poland's former deputy finance minister Krzysztof Kalicki has became a deputy president of large state-owned Pekao SA bank, the bank said in a statement on Thursday.
It said that last month the finance minister, the owner of Pekao SA, dismissed Kalicki as the head of the bank's supervisory board and appointed him the bank's first deputy president.
Wieslaw Fedorowicz, the current head of the ministry's banking system department, was appointed the head of Pekao's supervisory board.
Kalicki, 43, quit the finance ministry on January 1 on his own request, the finance ministry's press office said on Thursday. He was not immediately available for comment.
Pekao leads a group of four state-owned banks, created under a consolidation scheme last year to strengthen the banking system ahead of its opening to the international competition in 1999.
The group is to be partially sold off in 1998.
